newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Danish Feb unemployment seen down slightl.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Danish Feb unemployment seen down slightl.

text.p: Nine analysts polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Tuesday forecast that Danish unemployment would fall to a seasonally-corrected average year-on-year 8.2 percent of the workforce in February.
The equivalent figure for January was 8.3 percent. The estimates spanned from a low 8.1 percent to a high 8.3 percent.
The Danish national statistics office is due to issue its February jobless data on Thursday April 10 at 0730 gmt. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
